9.1 Widget setting

[書式]

  • widget set id [mode=mode]
  • no widget set

[設定値及び初期値]

  • id
    • [設定値] : Widget number (1..10)
    • [初期値] : -
  • mode

    • [設定値] :

      ValueMeaning
      fastA & B
      C < D
    • [初期値] : fast
  • auto : Automatic mode
    • [初期値] : -

[説明]

Sets the widget. See widget show.

line one
line two

[設定例]

# widget set 1
# widget set 2 mode=fast

[未知の節]

Something new

[適用モデル]

MODEL-A, MODEL-B
